name: Blackmaw Hold
summary: Blackmaw Hold is the ancestral redoubt of the Blackmaw furbolg, nestled against the northern cliffs of Azshara. Having served as the tribe's heartland since before the War of the Ancients, the village remains fiercely defended against all outsiders.

sections.title: An Ancient Stronghold
sections.body: Carved into the rugged northern mountains of Azshara, Blackmaw Hold serves as the historic center of power for the Blackmaw furbolg tribe. Their claim to these bluffs stretches back over ten thousand years to the era preceding the War of the Ancients. Sheltered beneath crude wooden palisades, bone pits, and carved effigies, the tribe lives in intense isolation, vigilantly guarding the surrounding crags and mountain passes against encroaching wanderers.

faq.answer: The settlement belongs to the Blackmaw furbolgs, an indigenous bear-folk tribe that has inhabited these mountains since the ancient world before the Great Sundering.

faq.q: How long has Blackmaw Hold existed?
faq.answer: The hold has served as the capital of the Blackmaw tribe for more than ten thousand years, having been established well before the War of the Ancients.
No. The Blackmaw furbolgs are deeply mistrustful of outsiders and fiercely territorial, attacking any travelers who draw near their bluffs and crude barricades.

angles.text: Night elves share a ten-thousand-year history with the furbolg tribes of northern Kalimdor, remembering the Blackmaws from the era preceding the Sundering.
Druids hold natural reverence for the bear-kin, though the deep hostility and isolation of the Blackmaw tribe make peaceful overtures difficult.
